items.title: 68091_Joe Turner oral history interview
items.q: Bobby Blue Bland. We was all down South at the same time... we run into one another... They were doin' the same thing... We used to all meet up together in this restaurant and have a ball.

ctx.x: Did you hear any blues down there that you hadn't heard before?

They was, uh...playin' my records, B.B. King's records, Lowell Fulson, T-Bone Walker. They was the favorite blues singers. Charles Brown, Ray Charles--we's all...we's all hangin' out down there together. Bobby Blue Bland. We was all down South at the same time but we wasn't playin' the same towns but we run into one another down there place called...lemme see what the name of that joint was... Old Man Dixons's Place. He had a...built a brand new hotel down there.
